solution = '''
def shortestPalindrome(s: str) -> str:
    if not s: return s
    combined = s + "#" + s[::-1]
    lps = [0] * len(combined)
    length = 0
    for i in range(1, len(combined)):
        while length and combined[i] != combined[length]:
            length = lps[length - 1]
        if combined[i] == combined[length]:
            length += 1
        lps[i] = length
    return s[lps[-1]:][::-1] + s
'''
FINAL(solution)
```

    for i in range(1, len(combined)):

        if combined[i] == combined[length]:
            length += 1
        lps[i] = length
    return s[lps[-1]:][::-1] + s
